title: Spain Installs Barrier After Border Rush Leaves At Least 67 Dead
summary: Spanish Interior Minister Fernando Grande-Marlaska announced plans to install a containment fence on the border with Morocco after 67 people died in a rush at the frontier. The incident occurred when migrants attempted to breach the border, and Spanish authorities responded with force. The government said it would take measures to prevent similar incidents in the future. The Prime Minister of Spain visited Ceuta, where the incident took place, to assess the situation. The death toll from the incident has risen to 67, with at least 57 migrants confirmed dead. The Spanish government claimed that the migrants were 'breaking the law' and vowed to be 'relentless against those who break the law'.
summary_points: At least 67 people died in a rush at the border between Spain and Morocco.
